title: Irish Lamb Skillet Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful lamb stew made with tender lamb, root vegetables, and a hint of bitterness from the bitter greens.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Choose a lean cut for best results

ingredients.name: Onions, chopped
ingredients.notes: Use a sweet onion for added flavor

ingredients.name: Carrots, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of orange and yellow carrots for added color

ingredients.name: Parsnips, peeled and chopped
ingredients.notes: Parsnips add a sweet and nutty flavor to the stew

ingredients.name: Bitter greens (such as kale or collard greens)
ingredients.notes: Bitter greens add a nice contrast to the rich lamb

ingredients.name: Skillet flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality all-purpose flour for best results

ingredients.name: Salt and pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for best flavor

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality water for best flavor

ingredients.name: Red wine (optional)
ingredients.notes: Red wine adds depth and complexity to the stew

instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onions, carrots, and parsnips to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the bitter greens, skillet flour, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the lamb back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the water and red wine (if using) to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the lamb is tender, about 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
